statements.text: Chris will fight for policies that protect American innovation from China's economic espionage and champion smart investments in American AI infrastructure that protect rural Texans from projects that drive up electricity rates and drain local water supplies. While we must win the global AI race, it is critical that we preserve our rural character and invest in infrastructure that benefits—not burdens—our local communities.
statements.venue: Campaign website (AI section, as reproduced on BallotReady)

statements.text: Put local communities first when data centers want to come to town: preserve our water, protect families from higher power bills, and require a clear economic benefit for local citizens.
statements.venue: Campaign website, Protect Rural Texas priority

statements.text:
Couldn’t agree more @POTUS.

Investing in AI & ensuring US dominance is critical — but not at the expense of working families, especially here in #TX10. My message is simple: if you want to do business in Texas, respect Texans & our resources — families shouldn’t be stuck paying your power bill.

I believe Texas should lead the country in AI and innovation, and that growth has to work for the communities that make it possible. That means protecting our water and power supply, building the infrastructure to support it, and making sure rural communities share in the benefits.
